newThisWeek.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Dashoot es un juego de plataformas de precisión en pixel art. Dispara a interruptores y mueve plataformas con tu cañón flotante. Recoge objetos para impulsos con distintas cargas, direcciones y distancias. Traza rutas subterráneas, reactiva centrales y descubre los secretos de la IA Deus.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

newThisWeek.name: Love in Summer
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Se acerca el verano y consigues un trabajo de fotógrafo en el campus. Te acompañan Liu Shilin, cariñosa; Li Feier, fría pero cálida por dentro; Xia Wei, modelo traviesa; y Le Tong, amiga de la infancia. Juntos preparan las fotos de graduación. Con ellas empieza tu verano de emociones…
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

newThisWeek.name: Funeral for the Sun
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Entre las cenizas de un pueblo abandonado y desentierra 400 años de maldición, encontrarás una historia de amor, traición y revolución. Sé testigo del pasado con tus propios ojos, descubre una red de secretos y revela la siniestra verdad de lo que duerme bajo los escombros.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

newThisWeek.name: Aviassembly
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡Construye y pilota tu propio avión! Completa misiones para ganar dinero, mejora tu avión y descubre nuevas ubicaciones en un mundo abierto.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

newThisWeek.name: Bottled by Bears
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡Únete a una familia de osos y administra el apiario más dulce del mundo! Colecciona y descubre abejas únicas, llena frascos de miel, expande tu granja y mira cómo florece tu campo en este acogedor juego idle de gestión.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

newThisWeek.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Crea tu imperio en la nieve: construye la acogedora estación de esquí de tus sueños en este juego de gestión. Adáptate al clima cambiante, traza pistas, coloca telesillas y construye alojamientos y bares de après-ski que mantendrán a miles de visitantes felices, calentitos y con la barriga llena.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

newThisWeek.name: Oboro no Ichi
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Construye y gestiona un mercado espiritual inspirado en Japón, da la bienvenida a espíritus errantes, produce y vende recursos y haz crecer tu espacio entre recuerdos y una atmósfera acogedora.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

newThisWeek.name: 9 Kings
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Levanta tu imperio en este trepidante constructor de reinos roguelike. Libra cruentas batallas contra tus homónimos rivales. Explota las mecánicas con cientos de construcciones increíbles para convertirte en el rey de reyes.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

newThisWeek.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
newThisWeek.shortDescription: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

newThisWeek.name: Frankenmine
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Un juego incremental en el que excavas tumbas malditas, recolectas huesos, carne y diversos recursos, y ensamblas tu propia criatura desde cero. Descubre poderosos artefactos, experimenta con combinaciones únicas y da vida a tu creación, pieza a pieza.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.

newThisWeek.name: One More Lawn
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Corta el pasto en primera persona arriba de un tractorcito destartalado, solo o en cooperativo online, hasta 6. Eres un viejo gruñón que fuma, toma cerveza barata y no le importa nada, pero deja franjas perfectas. Una vecina exigente, un campo de golf abandonado, una boda en una isla.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

newThisWeek.name: SONIC PICO PARK
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡La última entrega de la saga de acción y puzles cooperativos «PICO PARK» llega junto a «Sonic the Hedgehog» de SEGA, en una colaboración alucinante! ¡Montones de partidas cooperativas en las que destaca lo mejor de «Sonic» y de «PICO PARK»! ¡De 2 a 8 jugadores en modo local y online!
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

newThisWeek.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡Crea tu salón de depilación definitivo! Simula un salón exclusivo para hombres: usa láser médico de última generación para eliminar su vello, opera al límite del dolor, vende paquetes caros, mejora equipos, contrata personal y conviértelo en un santuario masculino.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.

newThisWeek.name: Progress98
newThisWeek.shortDescription: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!

newThisWeek.name: Nocturnal 2
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Prende tu espada y explora las torres más altas y los rincones más oscuros de una isla olvidada que se extinguió hace mucho tiempo.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

newThisWeek.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

newThisWeek.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!
newThisWeek.shortDescription: MATE, This Place is a MESS! es un juego cozy de ordenar 5.000 paquetes de yerba en un museo hecho un caos. Llená los estantes, cebate un mate, desbloqueá habilidades y pateá paquetes a su lugar. Al fondo del salón, un telón enorme esconde la verdad del museo. ¿Cuál será?
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?

newThisWeek.name: Icy Tower
newThisWeek.shortDescription: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

newThisWeek.name: After the Wane
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Siguiendo los pasos de una madre a la que nunca conoció, Lena intenta triunfar como bailarina en la ciudad. Atrapada en una disputa entre compañías de danza, lidiando con el amor, el desamor y los retos de la juventud, también debe batallar con la voz en su cabeza que comenta todo lo que hace.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Lena wants to step into the limelight, but the voice in her head has other plans. Between artistic ambitions, romance, family mysteries and the call of the occult, the ways toward your destiny are multiple and tortuous. Lena, Magdalena ou Madeleine… Who will you be when the curtain falls?

newThisWeek.name: Cake & Bake
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.

newThisWeek.name: Tape Man
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Tape Man es un juego de plataformas y puzles lleno de mecanismos ocultos. Lanza tu cinta métrica y explora un enorme laberinto hecho de puzles. Tu cinta es a la vez tu plataforma y tu obstáculo. Y puede hacer mucho más — solo tienes que descubrirlo.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.

newThisWeek.name: No Love No Money
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

newThisWeek.name: Journey TD
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Journey TD es un roguelite de defensa de torres donde tus torres son el laberinto. Elige tus elementos y escoge entre 168 torres. Combina potenciadores, equipo, runas y tres árboles de talentos en builds letales. Cada semana, reta a otros jugadores con el mismo seed por liderar la clasificación.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.

newThisWeek.name: Fat Goblins
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡Guerra de duendes 16 contra 16! Roba sombreros, asedia castillos, rescata a tu princesa regordeta y engorda a la enemiga con carne deliciosa. Desbloquea sombreros y clases y vuelve a la carga una y otra vez en un PvP absurdo y caótico.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & classes, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

topMonth.name: HELENA : Cloud District
topMonth.shortDescription: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

topMonth.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
topMonth.shortDescription: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

topMonth.name: Can 'Em All
topMonth.shortDescription: Un satisfactorio juego incremental en primera persona sobre convertir criaturas adorables en latas. Mátalas, recoge sus cuerpos, enlátalas y véndelas. Gana dinero, mejora tus armas y máquinas, y produce cada vez más.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

topMonth.name: Aviassembly
topMonth.shortDescription: ¡Construye y pilota tu propio avión! Completa misiones para ganar dinero, mejora tu avión y descubre nuevas ubicaciones en un mundo abierto.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

topMonth.name: Bottled by Bears

topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

topMonth.name: Desktop Duck
topMonth.shortDescription: Tu escritorio se merece un pato. Vive en tu pantalla, se posa en tus ventanas y reacciona a ti. Consigue sombreros en compañía y luego intercámbialos, véndelos o presume de ellos.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

topMonth.name: Stick A Fork
topMonth.shortDescription: ¡Un juego incremental adorable y lleno de dopamina! Basta con pasar el cursor. Clava tenedores en fruta gigante para ganar oro, compra más tenedores y elige bendiciones que formen sinergias. ¡Machaca la fruta, conviértela en mermelada y gástala en habilidades poderosas!
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!

hiddenGems.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Crea tu imperio en la nieve: construye la acogedora estación de esquí de tus sueños en este juego de gestión. Adáptate al clima cambiante, traza pistas, coloca telesillas y construye alojamientos y bares de après-ski que mantendrán a miles de visitantes felices, calentitos y con la barriga llena.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

hiddenGems.name: Get It Free
hiddenGems.shortDescription: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

hiddenGems.name: Oboro no Ichi
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Construye y gestiona un mercado espiritual inspirado en Japón, da la bienvenida a espíritus errantes, produce y vende recursos y haz crecer tu espacio entre recuerdos y una atmósfera acogedora.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

hiddenGems.name: Sushiamo
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Sushiamo es un roguelike de construcción de mazos donde haces sushi para alcanzar puntuaciones absurdas. ¡Descubre ingredientes únicos, salsas, herramientas que cambian el juego y navega por el mapa para romper el juego con combos de locura!
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

hiddenGems.name: Knuckle Creek
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.

hiddenGems.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.

hiddenGems.name: GloveUp!
hiddenGems.shortDescription: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

hiddenGems.name: TAKE MY BOMB
hiddenGems.shortDescription: TAKE MY BOMB es un juego de fiesta en línea: pasa la bomba a un amigo a tiempo para sobrevivir. ¡En los últimos 10 segundos, solo quien lleva la bomba ve el contador! ¿Quién sobrevivirá a este duelo de nervios con una bomba imprevisible? Antes de jugar, recuerda algo: “¡Con tal de que no sea yo!”
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: TAKE MY BOMB is an online party game: pass the bomb to a friend in time to survive. In the final 10 seconds, only the bomb holder sees the timer! Who will last to the end in a battle of wits over a bomb that could blow anytime? Before you start, remember one thing: “As long as it’s not me!”

hiddenGems.name: Dementium II
hiddenGems.shortDescription: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.

hiddenGems.name: Outcast Tales
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Vive el inicio de una gran aventura en Outcast Tales: The First Journey. Libra combates donde prima la estrategia, toma decisiones difíciles y escoge tus propias aventuras: ¡escribe la historia de tu grupo de marginados!
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: The game is not Free-to-Play, it's genuinely free. It's a challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions.

hiddenGems.name: Weeping Souls
hiddenGems.shortDescription: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

hiddenGems.name: MyDear.exe
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

upcoming.name: Trafficity
upcoming.shortDescription: Un simulador de construcción de ciudades centrado en el tráfico. Construye tu ciudad con herramientas de trazado de carreteras libremente, sin depender de cuadrículas. Resuelve los atascos de tráfico con rotondas, semáforos totalmente personalizables y grandes enlaces de autopistas.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, and sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

upcoming.name: just volleyball
upcoming.shortDescription: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

upcoming.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
upcoming.shortDescription: Juega a una ruleta rusa de chupitos con una diablilla que siente por ti un amor de los que matan. Se trata de un juego de supervivencia donde o provocas que ella vomite su alma o será la tuya la que potes. Cuanto más bebas, más reglas podrás saltarte... te lo pasarás de muerte.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

upcoming.name: Am I Nima
upcoming.shortDescription: Am I Nima es un juego de terror psicológico en el que tendrás que convencer a tu madre de que eres su hija de verdad. Junta palabras en tu cerebro para expresarlas y lograr que ella confíe en ti.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

upcoming.name: Here Comes the Horde
upcoming.shortDescription: «Here Comes the Horde» es un juego de combate automático e incremental en el que mandas tropas a defender tu castillo contra hordas de muertos vivientes. Sobrevive a los ataques, desbloquea nuevas unidades, consigue poderosas habilidades e invade la pantalla con tropas por doquier.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.

upcoming.name: Dear Passengers
upcoming.shortDescription: Juega en cooperativo como la tripulación de la peor aerolínea del mundo. Tu avión se cae a pedazos, tu carga es ilegal, y la seguridad de los pasajeros apenas entra en la lista de prioridades.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

upcoming.name: HARMA
upcoming.shortDescription: HARMA es un juego de construcción de mazos roguelike de alta dificultad que combina una historia dura con una experiencia de juego extremadamente desafiante. Los demonios están destruyendo este mundo. Lucha contra los males del mundo en un destino irracional. Y demuestra que estuviste aquí.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

upcoming.name: SHRED A BILLION
upcoming.shortDescription: SHRED A BILLION es un juego incremental en primera persona sobre una montaña de dinero. ¡Coge billetes con las manos, recógelos con un cubo, sube de nivel y échale mil millones de dólares a la trituradora! ¡Solo quedan 3.929.120.202 billetes!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!

upcoming.name: Jyoka -Castle town-
upcoming.shortDescription: "Jyoka" es un juego de estrategia y construcción del siglo XVI en Japón. Desarrolla tu territorio con más de 190 instalaciones y otorga arrozales a tus vasallos. Conéctate y defiéndete de bandidos o daimyos. ¡Asedia más de 70 castillos reales y unifica el país!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: "Jyoka" is a 16th-century Japanese castle town builder. Develop your territory with 190+ facilities and grant rice fields to retainers to secure loyalty. Defend against bandits and daimyos. Once stable, launch epic sieges against 70+ real-inspired castles to unify Japan!

upcoming.name: No Asteroids
upcoming.shortDescription: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.

upcoming.name: Reshine
upcoming.shortDescription: Restaura antigüedades limpiando las capas de polvo, óxido y el paso del tiempo. Reshine es una experiencia minimalista y relajante. Usa herramientas para ver cómo años de suciedad desaparecen ante tus ojos. Sin complicaciones, sin presión, solo la satisfacción de devolver vida a tesoros vintage.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

upcoming.name: Sol One
upcoming.shortDescription: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

upcoming.name: Lost Bitcoin
upcoming.shortDescription: Lost Bitcoin es un juego de excavación y automatización en una gigantesca chatarrería. Recoge chatarra, quémala para conseguir monedas, compra mejoras y construye una fábrica que trabaje para ti. Abre cajas y cajas fuertes, y revisa cada memoria USB para encontrar tu monedero de Bitcoin perdido.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

upcoming.name: Network & Cyber Security Simulator
upcoming.shortDescription: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!

upcoming.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
upcoming.shortDescription: 2040. Despiertas en una ciudad invadida por otro mundo. Puedes excavar el terreno sin límites. Apilando bloques puedes construir casas, castillos y fortalezas. Las chicas monstruo que encuentres en las tierras salvajes se convertirán en tus compañeras si las capturas. Lucharán y vivirán a tu lado para sostener tu reino.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

upcoming.name: Frog Collector
upcoming.shortDescription: Pon orden en una tienda repleta de ranas coleccionables. Recoge y clasifica figuras de colores, llena estanterías temáticas, desbloquea mejoras útiles y busca huevos escondidos. Completa tu colección rana a rana.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

upcoming.name: Code Market
upcoming.shortDescription: Code Market es un juego de gestión tranquilo: no haces clic, escribes Java o C# de verdad. El robot hace justo lo que dice tu código: ir a la estantería, coger tomates, tomar pedidos, llenar bolsas y reponer. De las variables a la herencia, jugando, o automatiza el supermercado entero.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java or C# code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

upcoming.name: Rec Room: A New Semester
upcoming.shortDescription: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

upcoming.name: Link Loop
upcoming.shortDescription: Link Loop es un juego de plataformas y puzles en 2D basado en portales y una física muy satisfactoria. Usa portales para mover objetos, redirigir láseres y transportar fluidos. Los niveles tienen varias soluciones, y la creatividad es clave.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics. Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.

upcoming.name: Space Station Designer
upcoming.shortDescription: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.
